Actual Ioudaia is a dative feminine singular Jewish ethnic adjective agreeing with the wife in the source participial clause, rendered a-Jewess in English. The real A-DSF analysis remains rather than a Greek female-person noun tag.
Actual autou genitive is the heard person, rendered direct English him without changing the actual source case to accusative.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual articles with Felix, his-wife, Paul and faith are not separately expressed in English.
Actual N1904 explicitly adds Jesus after Christ in the faith object. LSV follows the shorter printed TR Christ wording without that Jesus title; no earlier/later English Jesus word is borrowed here.

24:25.sourceText: διαλεγομένου δὲ αὐτοῦ περὶ δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἐγκρατείας καὶ τοῦ κρίματος τοῦ μέλλοντος ἔμφοβος γενόμενος ὁ Φῆλιξ ἀπεκρίθη Τὸ νῦν ἔχον πορεύου, καιρὸν δὲ μεταλαβὼν μετακαλέσομαί σε·
24:25.targetText: and he reasoning concerning righteousness, and self-control, and the judgment that is about to be, Felix, having become afraid, answered, “For the present be going, and having time, I will call for you”;

groups.note: Actual autou genitive is the reasoning absolute-clause subject, rendered English he. Its real genitive case is retained rather than a new nominative pronoun.

Actual mellontos is a present active genitive neuter singular future/impending participle modifying judgment, rendered is-about. Its real participial form remains; the extra TR being infinitive is explained independently.

Actual to nyn echon article/now/having participle is the current-time circumstance idiom, rendered For-the-present. All three original words remain as that one formula, without an independent Greek present-time noun or for preposition.
Actual metalabon is an aorist active taking/obtaining participle, rendered having with the opportunity/time object. The source remains metalambano, not an invented echo have verb.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article with Felix is not separately expressed in English.

unmappedTarget.reason: Printed TR adds esesthai future being infinitive after the coming/about-to participle. Exact N1904 has the coming participle without this independently printed being complement; no source being word is invented here.

24:26.sourceText: ἅμα καὶ ἐλπίζων ὅτι χρήματα δοθήσεται αὐτῷ ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου· διὸ καὶ πυκνότερον αὐτὸν μεταπεμπόμενος ὡμίλει αὐτῷ.
24:26.targetText: and at the same time also hoping that money will be given to him by Paul, that he may release him, therefore, also sending for him often, he was conversing with him;

groups.note: Actual dothesetai is a future passive third-singular giving predicate with neuter plural money subject, rendered will-be-given; the source agreement and future form remain unchanged.

Actual pyknōteron has A-ASN-C comparative adjective analyses in both raw fields, used adverbially for more-frequently. LSV renders often; the actual comparative source form remains rather than a fabricated positive adverb tag.
Actual metapempomenos has functional V-PMP-NSM/formal V-PEP-NSM present nonactive sending-for participial analyses, retained without a finite source retagging.
Actual auto dative is the conversing companion/complement, rendered with-him without a separately printed Greek with preposition.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article with Paul is not separately expressed by English.

unmappedTarget.reason: Printed TR additionally has de in the opening temporal/also-hope connection. Exact N1904 begins hama-kai without this independent initial conjunction; actual kai owns the separate also.

Printed TR adds the releasing-purpose clause hopos lyse auton. Exact N1904 has no corresponding release head, purpose marker or extra object here; existing money-recipient and later sending/conversing pronouns are not borrowed into that missing clause.

24:27.sourceText: Διετίας δὲ πληρωθείσης ἔλαβεν διάδοχον ὁ Φῆλιξ Πόρκιον Φῆστον· θέλων τε χάριτα καταθέσθαι τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις ὁ Φῆλιξ κατέλιπε τὸν Παῦλον δεδεμένον.
24:27.targetText: and two years having been fulfilled, Felix received a successor, Porcius Festus; Felix also willing to lay a favor on the Jews, left Paul bound.

groups.note: Actual dietias is one genitive feminine singular two-year-period noun, rendered two-years without separate Greek two numeral and years noun source identities.
Actual charita is N-ASF singular favor in both pinned fields. Printed TR has plural charitas; the named LSV singular a-favor matches the actual noun number rather than the other reading.
Actual dative article/Jewish ethnic adjective jointly supplies on-the-Jews as the favor recipients, retaining actual A-DPM source morphology and no independently printed Greek on preposition.
Actual dedemenon is a perfect passive accusative masculine singular bound participle, retained under bound without an aorist source tag.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual articles with the two Felix occurrences and Paul are not separately expressed in English.
